sentences.text: Shri Surdeep Khampariya - Advocate for the applicant.
Ms. Priti Singh - Panel Lawyer for the respondent/State.

Order 
This is second application filed by the applicant under Section 483 of the Bhartiya Nagrik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 for grant of regular bail relating to FIR/Crime No.307/2024 dated 29.06.2024 registered at Police Station Athner, District Betul (M.P.) for the offences punishable under Sections 363, 376(3), 506, 34 of IPC and Section 3 read with Section 4 of POCSO Act.

2 . Previous application of the applicant filed vide M.Cr.C. No.36227/2024 was dismissed on merit by this Court vide order dated 06.09.2024.
3.
The counsel for the applicant contends that the applicant is innocent and has been falsely implicated in the case.

After dismissal of earlier application statement of the prosecutrix, mother,
father and maternal uncle has been recorded, None of these prosecution witnesses supported the prosecution story.

On the contrary they have turned hostile, therefore, present applicant deserves to be enlarged on bail, inasmuch as, there is no DNA NEUTRAL CITATION NO.
2025:MPHC-JBP:6094 2 MCRC-54509-2024 report to corroborate the prosecution story.

4. The counsel for the State has opposed the application and submitted that in the statement recorded under Section 164 of Cr.P.C the victim levelled the allegation against the present applicant,
therefore, he is not entitled for bail.
5.
Heard the submissions and perused the case diary.

sentences.text: 6. Considering the totality of the facts and circumstances of the case, the fact that the statement of the prosecutrix, mother, father and maternal uncle have already been recorded and the age and period of incarceration of the applicant, this Court deems it to be a fit case to release the applicant on bail.
Therefore, without expressing any view on the merits of the case, the application is allowed.

7. It is directed that the applicant shall be released on bail on furnishing a personal bond in a sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand Only) with one surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court concerned for his appearance before the said Court on all such dates as may be fixed in this regard during the pendency of trial.
8. It is further directed that the applicant shall comply with the provisions of Section 480(3) of the Bhartiya Nagrik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023.

(MANINDER S. BHATTI) JUDGE Vin**
